about: Shared AcadeGrade academic-rules cases. Byte-identical copies live at acadegrade-web/tests/fixtures/academic-rules.json and acadegrade-mobile/tests/fixtures/academic-rules.json. Both test suites pin its sha256 (LF line endings), so edit both copies and both hashes together. Special inputs: the strings "NaN" and "undefined" stand for those JavaScript values.

gradeFromScore.note: float noise from summing CA and exam is not a lower grade
fractional totals between bands take the lower band, never F

courseMetrics.name: CA plus exam gives the grade and a continuous PI point
zero scores are a real F
letter grade only is estimated with PI equal to the grade point
one score missing does not invent a total
awaiting result keeps its flag so GPA can skip it
pending share-code import keeps its flag so GPA can skip it

semesterGpa.name: awaiting-result and pending rows do not count
a semester of only awaiting results has no GPA yet
letter-grade rows count with their grade point

cumulativeCgpa.name: weights each semester by its credit load
graded credits count whether or not the semester is marked complete
a semester with no graded credits is ignored

formatCgpa.note: toFixed(2) shows 0.99 here while the class is Pass

requiredAverageForTarget.note: above 5.00 means the target is out of reach; callers decide how to show it
negative is returned unchanged; callers clamp for display

isCarryOver.name: awaiting result is not a carry-over
pending import is not a carry-over
pending import with a placeholder F is not a carry-over
no score and no grade is unknown, not a carry-over
one score missing and no grade is unknown

outstandingCarryOvers.name: a failed course passed later is cleared, matching normalised codes
a failed course never retaken stays outstanding
retaken and failed again is listed once
a later awaiting result does not clear it
a later pending import does not clear it
a later row with no score or grade does not clear it
a letter-grade pass clears a letter-grade fail
a fail after an earlier pass is outstanding
order follows the first failure of each outstanding course
whitespace and case variants are the same course

endToEnd.name: 539 grade points over 120 units shows 4.49 and is 2:1, not Fail
awaiting results never drag the CGPA down

weightedAverageScore.name: equals the continuous PI average x 20 when nothing is excluded
CA plus exam wins over a stored total score
falls back to the total score when CA or exam is missing
leaves out awaiting-result, pending and score-less rows
leaves out grade-only estimated rows and counts them separately
is null when no row has a score
a real zero score counts and drags the average down
rows with no usable units are left out

creditLoadWarnings.name: no range and no duplicates means no warnings
a load inside the range is quiet, and the edges are inside
awaiting-result rows still count toward the registered load
duplicates match ignoring case and spaces and are listed once
duplicates are reported before range problems
blank codes are not duplicates, and an empty semester does not warn
an empty semester has no range warning

scaleById.note: custom scales have no fixed definition; use validateCustomScale or resolveGradingScale

scaledCourseMetrics.name: nbte4: CA plus exam, PI is total / 100 x 4
nbte4: full marks reach the 4.00 top point
nbte4: a two-letter grade only is estimated
nbte4: letter matching ignores case and spaces
ng5-noE: a letter not on the scale counts as nothing known
ng5-noE: 42 is a fail without the E band
nce5: no score and no grade
nbte4: awaiting result keeps its flag

scaledSemesterGpa.name: nbte4: awaiting-result and pending rows do not count; distribution lists every nbte4 grade
ng5-noE: a 42 counts as F with 0 points
nce5: letter-grade rows count with their grade point

scaledEndToEnd.name: nbte4: two semesters give 3.04, Upper Credit
nce5: 539 grade points over 120 units shows 4.49 and is Credit
ng5 passed explicitly matches the default

scaledTargets.note: above 4.00 is out of reach on a 4-point scale

scaledCarryOver.name: ng5-noE: 42 fails without the E band
ng5-noE: a letter not on the scale is unknown, not a carry-over
nbte4: awaiting result is not a carry-over

scaledOutstandingCarryOvers.name: ng5-noE: a 42 fail is not cleared by a later letter that is not on the scale
nbte4: a failed course passed later is cleared

customScaleValid.name: labels are trimmed and upper-cased, bands and classes sorted highest first
the smallest scale: two bands, one class, default name

customScaleInvalid.name: an array is not a scale
bad band fields are reported per band
no band starts at 0, and a higher band is worth fewer points
the band at 0 must be worth 0 points
top grade point out of range
missing top grade point and missing lists

input.name: A scale name that is longer than forty chars

customScaleInvalid.name: bad class fields are reported per class

classes.name: A class name over thirty chars!

resolveGradingScale.name: nce5 with invalid boundaries falls back to the default NCE classes
an invalid custom scale falls back to ng5
custom with nothing stored falls back to ng5
